ux_intent: TEMPLATE. Fill bracketed placeholders with the specific screen's details after story B-7 defines the batch assignments. Purpose: validate that the migrated screen survives rotation, handles all required states, and matches the established ViewModel + Compose design pattern.
figma_make_prompt:
[TEMPLATE — replace every bracketed value before pasting into Figma Make]

Build a [Screen Name] screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Use a [top app bar with title "[Screen Title]" and a back arrow / bottom navigation with [Active Tab] tab active].

Layout:
- [Vertical scroll / single viewport / grid]. Horizontal padding 16px.
- [Describe the primary content area: what sections exist, what hierarchy they follow.]
- [Describe each key element: what it shows, left/right/centre alignment, dimensions.]
- [Describe any interactive elements: buttons, toggles, inputs, links — each with a touch target note.]

States:
- Loading: [skeleton placeholder description — match the dimensions of the loaded content].
- Default / Loaded: [describe the initial populated state with representative data].
- Error: [inline error banner or full-screen error with a retry action].
- [Any additional states this screen requires: empty, success, confirmation, selected item, etc.]

Behavior:
- When [primary action] is tapped → [outcome and state change].
- When [secondary action] is tapped → [outcome].
- [Network or error handling description].

Style:
- Material 3-ish, neutral. Background #F9FAFB (list screens) or #FFFFFF (form / detail screens). Primary #6366F1. Error #EF4444. Success #10B981. Auto layout, responsive.
- All tap targets ≥ 48x48dp. Body text ≥ 14sp. Headers ≥ 16sp.

First step: [describe the single most important state to start the Make generation with — usually the default/loaded state with the primary interaction visible].
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the screen is in the loaded state
When the user views it
Then all primary content is visible and the layout matches the approved design

Given the screen is loading
When the screen is rendered
Then skeleton placeholders appear in the same dimensions as the loaded content and no raw data or broken layout is visible

Given the user performs the primary action on this screen
When the action completes
Then the expected state change or navigation occurs as described in the story

Given the screen encounters a network error
When the error state is rendered
Then an inline error with a retry action is visible and the user can recover without leaving the screen
manual_validation_checklist: Verify all interactive elements have touch targets ≥ 48x48dp
Confirm body text ≥ 14sp, headers ≥ 16sp. Check contrast: primary text on background ≥ 4.5:1, secondary text ≥ 3:1
Verify loading skeletons fill the same space as loaded content — no layout shift on transition
Confirm error state banner or message is visible and the retry CTA is a distinct tappable element
Check auto layout is applied: no overlapping elements at different content lengths or text sizes
Verify the screen matches the ViewModel pattern: state is exposed via the UI (not held in the view), and rotation would preserve visible content
